title: Contextual Candour: Role-Aware Graduated Disclosure for LLMs over Mixed-Sensitivity Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2610.28067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs increasingly operate over mixed-sensitivity contexts, where they must reason over information ranging from public to confidential while disclosing only what the user is authorised to receive. Existing approaches enforce access control as a binary decision: either fully answering or refusing, without regulating how much or what kind of information is revealed if access is granted, leading to over-refusal or unintended leakage. We introduce graduated disclosure, an access-control formulation in which the level of detail and sensitivity in a model's response is calibrated to the user's authorisation rather than treated as a grant-or-deny decision. We model graduated disclosure as a disclosure-aware generation problem and propose a reward-based optimisation framework that shapes responses toward level-appropriate abstractions while penalising unauthorised factual leakage, including paraphrases and approximations. translated_title: 情境坦诚：面向大语言模型在混合敏感度语境下的角色感知分级披露
translated_abstract: 大语言模型日益在混合敏感度的语境中运行，它们需要推理从公开到机密的各种信息，同时只披露用户被授权获取的内容。现有方法将访问控制作为二元决策来执行：要么完整回答，要么拒绝，而未能在授予访问权限后对披露的信息量或信息类型加以约束，从而导致过度拒绝或意外的信息泄露。我们提出了“分级披露”这一访问控制形式化方法，其中模型回答的细节程度和敏感度根据用户的授权级别进行校准，而非简单地将决策视为“授予或拒绝”。我们将分级披露建模为一个披露感知的生成问题，并提出基于奖励的优化框架，使模型的回答朝向与授权级别相称的抽象层次，同时惩罚未经授权的事实性泄露，包括改写和近似表述等。我们评估了我们的方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“分级披露”概念，将大语言模型在混合敏感度信息上的访问控制从非黑即白的“授予或拒绝”决策，革新为根据用户授权级别校准回答细节与敏感度的生成方式，并通过基于奖励的优化框架在惩罚改写、近似等隐性泄露的同时，引导模型生成与授权相称的回答。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "graduated disclosure," reformulating access control for LLMs over mixed-sensitivity contexts from a binary grant-or-deny decision into authorisation-calibrated response detail, using a reward-based optimisation framework that shapes level-appropriate abstractions while penalising unauthorised factual leakage such as paraphrases and approximations.
